newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha flat in two-tier market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha flat in two-tier market.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were flat on Monday amid steady futures, traders said.
June swaps were talked at around $188 and the contango into July appeared to have widened slightly to around $1.25.

This widening of the spread, dealers said, was partly because of a small late rise in crude oil futures which had boosted July numbers, as well as a small deal on Friday of some early June Dow quality naphtha at $180 cif NWE which had contributed to some bearish sentiment on the prompt market.
But this remains a two-tier market, with bids for 25,000 tonne lots of pipeline quality naphtha heard as high as $190 cif NWE.
